results.title: S. Korean firm plans $150 million lifeline for Eric Trump-backed robot maker
results.content: NEW YORK — South Korean conglomerate Base Group is preparing to invest $150 million in a struggling military-robot maker backed by U.S. President Donald Trump's son Eric, internal company emails show, deepening the firm’s ties to the Trump family that have already drawn congressional scrutiny. Foundation Future Industries, which makes gun-carrying “Terminator”-style robot soldiers and employs Eric Trump as chief strategy adviser, stopped paying employees in recent weeks and is pinning its future on Base Group’s funding, according to CEO Sankaet Pathak's emails to employees seen by Reuters. “My read, given where Base is, this is a timing issue, not an existential one for the company,” Pathak wrote in a November 8 email, referring to the payroll issues.
